items.exampleEn: She is capable of running a big company.
items.exampleZh: 她有能力經營一家大公司。

items.exampleEn: This ring is made of pure gold.
Many students live in nearby towns.
items.exampleZh: 許多學生住在附近的城鎮。

items.exampleEn: For no apparent reason, the baby started to cry.
items.exampleZh: 寶寶沒有明顯的原因就哭了起來。

items.exampleEn: She walked rapidly toward the door.
A giant tree stood in the middle of the park.
items.exampleZh: 一棵巨大的樹立在公園中央。

items.exampleEn: Our cat normally sleeps on the sofa in the afternoon.
items.exampleZh: 我們的貓下午通常睡在沙發上。

items.exampleEn: She has an extraordinary memory for faces.

items.sentenceEn: Prices are rising rapidly this year.

items.audioEn: The museum is normally open until six, but today it closes at four because of a special event.
items.audioZh: 博物館通常開到六點，但今天因為特別活動四點就關門。

items.sentenceEn: There is a nice park nearby.
items.sentenceZh: 附近有一座不錯的公園。

items.sentenceEn: This little robot is capable of cleaning the whole house.
items.sentenceZh: 這個小機器人能打掃整間房子。

items.stemZh: 我們享受著純淨的山間空氣。

items.stemEn: The new game became popular so ____ that everyone in my class was playing it within a week.
items.stemZh: 那款新遊戲紅得非常快，一週內我們班每個人都在玩。

items.passageEn: Last weekend, my family visited a nearby farm. Normally, we spend our weekends at home, but this time my mom wanted us to see something extraordinary: a giant melon that was bigger than me! The farmer told us it had grown rapidly in the summer heat. The plant had adapted well to the hot weather. It was apparent that he was proud of it. He also showed us a small river with pure, clear water. My little brother asked, "Am I capable of growing a melon like that?" The farmer laughed and gave him some seeds.
items.passageZh: 上週末，我們全家去附近的一座農場。平常我們週末都待在家裡，但這次媽媽想讓我們看看一樣非凡的東西：一顆比我還大的巨大甜瓜！農夫告訴我們，這顆甜瓜在夏天的高溫裡長得很快。這株植物很能適應炎熱的天氣。很明顯他非常以它為傲。他還帶我們看了一條水質純淨清澈的小河。我弟弟問：「我有能力種出那樣的甜瓜嗎？」農夫笑了，送給他一些種子。

options: 去幫農夫採收很多蔬菜水果
去看一顆比我還大的甜瓜
甜瓜在夏天為什麼長得這麼快
農場裡一共養了多少隻動物
自己能不能種出那種甜瓜

items.promptZh: 很明顯，他忘了我們的約會。
referenceEn: It was apparent that he forgot our date.
It was apparent that he had forgotten our date.
rubricZh: apparent 表示「明顯的」，例如 It is apparent that… 等說法
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式等）

items.instructionZh: 用 normally 造一個句子，說說你週末通常會做什麼。
referenceEn: I normally visit my grandparents on Sundays.
On weekends, I normally sleep until nine.
rubricZh: normally 表示「通常」，例如 I normally… 等說法
說的是自己的習慣（例如 I）
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式；說過去的事用過去式等）
